rules: Domain layer has no framework dependencies
Ports define interfaces in domain, adapters implement in infrastructure
Application services orchestrate domain logic through ports
Inbound adapters (REST controllers) live in infrastructure/adapter/in/
Outbound adapters (persistence, integrations) live in infrastructure/adapter/out/

reviewScopes.name: Architecture Compatibility
reviewScopes.description: Hexagonal architecture compliance, layer violations, dependency direction

reviewScopes.name: Code Quality (DRY, SOLID, Clean Code)
reviewScopes.description: Duplication, naming, complexity, single responsibility, interface segregation

reviewScopes.name: Security
reviewScopes.description: OWASP top 10, secrets handling, injection, auth, .agentic-rules compliance

reviewScopes.name: Test Coverage
reviewScopes.description: Test existence for changes, coverage gaps, test quality and patterns

reviewScopes.name: Performance
reviewScopes.description: N+1 queries, blocking calls, resource leaks, unbounded collections, scalability
